(I) Exquisite and detailed graphics style

From the mist-shrouded Beiling Courtyard to the towering Qingxuan College, and from the snowy Xuanling Mountain to the majestic fantasy realm, the game provides players with one dreamlike scene after another. The fresh and bright art style provides an immersive gaming experience for every player who enters the game.

(II) Extremely refreshing combat experience

As a role-playing game with action as its selling point, whether it is a swordsman holding a Qingfeng and sweeping across thousands of troops, or a boxer with a majestic momentum and overwhelming the heroes, the performance of the action in the game shows the top action audio-visual experience in the current gaming industry. Such a sweat-drenched image is a masterpiece that any game player must play.

(III) Innovative gaming experience

Today's mobile game market can be described as a battle of heroes, and major manufacturers have launched their own signature works, but the stereotyped style and extremely similar gameplay inevitably make many players aesthetically fatigued. As a conscientious development team that makes games with heart, it has assembled a group of idealistic, faithful and motivated young people, who have carefully designed and repeatedly polished a variety of gameplay systems. From the gripping game plot to the colorful and wonderful character development, they all reflect the ingenious creativity and unremitting efforts of the production staff.
